items.text: New England (Wednesday): no one missed practice; WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), C Ben Brown (knee), OT Morgan Moses (foot) and DT DaQuan Jones were limited. G Alijah Vera-Tucker is on IR.
New England RB TreVeyon Henderson missed Thursday's practice with an undisclosed issue (possibly his Week 5 ankle).

Miami (Wednesday): CB JuJu Brents (neck/concussion) and OL Kadyn Proctor (concussion) did not practice; WR Malik Washington (knee), S Michael Taaffee (neck/foot) and TE Greg Dulcich (ankle) were limited. RB De'Von Achane is out for the season. Malik Willis starts.
